_what: Nifty 50 calendar-year price returns, computed from December close to December close out of the monthly OHLC series Rahul supplied on 2026-08-15. The raw file sits beside this as nifty50-monthly-1990-2026.csv.
_basis: PRICE RETURN. Dividends are not included, so the compound return here understates a real holder's by roughly the dividend yield, historically about 1.0-1.5% a year. Volatility is essentially unaffected.
_provenance: Supplied by Rahul, 434 monthly rows, Jul 1990 to Aug 2026. Validated against an independently fetched published price-return series: 24 of 27 overlapping years agree to within 0.05 percentage points.
_supersedes: Replaces the secondary series fetched earlier, which was WRONG in two years - it gave 1999 as +8.7% against an actual +67.4%, and 1997 as +10.6% against +20.1%. Both errors sat in a table that looked entirely authoritative. This is why the file was cross-checked and why the raw data is kept.
_caveat: The Nifty 50 was launched in 1996; values before that are back-calculated by the index provider.

derived._note: Computed from the series above. sd is the standard deviation of ANNUAL calendar-year returns, which is the quantity the SWP engine's sigma multiplies.

dividendContribution._what: How much dividends added, measured rather than assumed: the Nifty 50 TRI compound return minus the price compound return over the SAME years, 2005-2025.
dividendContribution._tri_source: Bajaj AMC citing 'NSE Indices Limited, Nifty 50 Whitepaper 2026'. Held only for this one subtraction; the price series in this file is the figure of record.
